content.title: Criminal Defense Attorney OKC - Phillips & Associates
content.text: One of Oklahoma City's Top Criminal Defense Law FirmsAn Oklahoma criminal defense lawyer provides legal representation to individuals accused of committing a criminal offense. The criminal defense attorneys at Phillips & Associates aggressively defend clients facing criminal charges ranging from misdemeanors to felonies. The criminal law firm's knowledge of Oklahoma criminal law, court procedures, and criminal defense strategies allow the attorneys to analyze evidence, challenge the allegations of the prosecution, and successfully fight for the best outcome in every case. These outcomes include dismissals, a reduction in charges, reduced sentencing, or acquittals.Finding the best Oklahoma City criminal defense attorney involves comparing law firms based on trial experience, online reviews, references, and the firm's record of success in high stakes criminal cases. Since 2009, Phillips & Associates has focused on protecting clients' rights, negotiating with prosecutors to reduce or dismiss charges, and providing aggressive representation at criminal trials. The firm’s attorneys review expert testimony, forensic evidence, investigative reports, and procedural issues in order to identify weaknesses in the state's case. Phillips & Associates offers free consultations, clear pricing, and multiple payment options. Hiring an attorney from the firm provides clients with experienced legal defense for serious criminal charges.
